title: On Detecting a change in her voice
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：detect　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 detect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the builder ① detected a change in her voice on the same day, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② detects a change in her voice before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ detect a change in her voice at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ detected a change in her voice before — a line in the plan for October 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Detecting a change in her voice on the same day, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ detect the fault in the third joint before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Detect the fault in the third joint at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ detects the fault in the third joint on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ detected a change in her voice again when nobody else would.

⑩ To detect a change in her voice, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody detects a change in her voice before dawn again and somebody must detect a change in her voice on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 察觉（一般过去式 detected a change in her voice：1951 年施工员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 察觉（一般现在 detects a change in her voice：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 察觉（不定式 to detect a change in her voice：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 察觉（过去完成时 had detected a change in her voice：1945 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 察觉（动名词 detecting a change in her voice 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 查出（detect the fault in the third joint：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去查出查出第三节接口上的毛病）
G. v. 查出（detect the fault in the third joint：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 察觉（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 detects the fault in the third joint，而母亲又一次 detected a change in her voice）

answers.why: detect 意为“察觉”，1951 年施工员当天就察觉察觉她声气里的变化，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 detected。
detect 意为“察觉”，自那以后施工员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 detects。
detect 意为“察觉”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯察觉察觉她声气里的变化”，此处为不定式 to detect a change in her voice。
detect 意为“察觉”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人察觉过，故用过去完成时 had detected。
detect 意为“察觉”，施工员说“察觉察觉她声气里的变化这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 detecting a change in her voice 作主语。
detect 意为“查出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去查出查出第三节接口上的毛病”，should ever 之后用原形 detect the fault in the third joint。
detect 意为“查出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻查出查出第三节接口上的毛病（detect the fault in the third joint at once），以后再也不要提起。
detect 意为“察觉”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例查出查出第三节接口上的毛病，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 detects。
detect 意为“察觉”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就察觉察觉她声气里的变化，用一般过去式 detected 叙述。
detect 意为“察觉”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要察觉察觉她声气里的变化，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

多年以后，施工员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（detects a change in her voice）

施工员说过，当天就察觉察觉她声气里的变化这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（detecting a change in her voice 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻查出查出第三节接口上的毛病，以后再也不要提起。（detect the fault in the third joint，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 detect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the builder detected a change in her voice on the same day, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder detects a change in her voice before dawn whenever the site asks.
Detecting a change in her voice on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever detect the fault in the third joint before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site detects the fault in the third joint on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother detected a change in her voice again, and the site remembered that half.
